cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Which photo should go on the reunion poster? Mine or Sam's?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Sharpness first. Would you at least show the committee mine first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send both together. Same size.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Equal treatment. After three weekends helping you move. Could mine at least be the attachment they open first? Just readability.

mechanism: A uses professional photo-selection corrections to turn small ordering decisions into unacknowledged tests of whether B values A past help.
confusable: Simple editorial preference lacks the personal judgement of each answer and the renewed small favour after a neutral response.
comparison: Moving alternative tests priority through availability rather than treatment of creative work.
seedUse: Poster seed supplies sharper rival photo and equal sizing; S03 gives a real composition criterion before increasingly strained priority corrections.
